Appearance:
MR J A KUMAWAT(11440) for the Applicant(s) No. 1 MR RJ GOSWAMI(1102) for the Applicant(s) No. 1 MR PRANAV TRIVEDI, APP for the Respondent(s) No. 1 ==========================================================
 CORAM:HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE ILESH J. VORA  Date : 21/02/2023
ORAL ORDER 1.

The applicant, by way of this successive application filed under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, seeks regular bail in connection with the FIR being C.R. No.11823004220431 of 2022 registered with Dediyapada Police Station, Dist. Narmada, for the offences punishable under Sections 406, 420 and 120(B) of the IPC.
2. It is the submission of learned counsel for the applicant that he is suffering confinement since 05.07.2022 and charge- sheet has already been filed.
It is stated that the applicant is not having any past antecedents of like nature.
Hence, further detention of the applicant is unwarranted.

3. Learned APP has opposed the bail application contending that, considering the conduct of the applicant and nature of R/CR.MA/22158/2022 ORDER DATED: 21/02/2023 accusation, the discretion may not be exercised in favour of the applicant.

sentences.text: Having regard to the facts and circumstances of the case, it appears that, the applicant was employed by the principal accused with monthly salary of Rs.10,000/- and had performed his duty as a Manager with the company as referred in the case papers.
During the course of investigation, it reveals that, whatever amount he received from different persons, had been transmitted to the principal accused through Google Pay and/or PhonePe.
In such circumstances, prima-facie, it appears that, the applicant did not have received any monetary benefits, nor, he was part of criminal conspiracy hatched by the principal accused.
When the applicant does not have any past criminal record and his further custody is not necessary, this Court is of the view that the applicant has made out a case for bail.
The Authorities will release the applicant only if he is not required in connection with any other offence for the time being.
If breach of any of the above conditions is committed, the Sessions Judge concerned will be free to issue warrant or take appropriate action in the matter.
Bail bond to be executed before the learned Lower Court having jurisdiction to try the case.
It will be open for the concerned Court to delete, modify and/or relax any of the above conditions, in accordance with law.

At the trial, learned Trial Court shall not be influenced by the observations of preliminary nature,
qua the evidence at this stage, made by this Court while enlarging the applicant on bail.
Rule is made absolute to the aforesaid extent.
Direct service is permitted.

(ILESH J. VORA,J) TAUSIF SAIYED Jaydeepkumar Harilal Vasava vs State Of Gujarat on 21 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/192341007/
